#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Senior Staff Specialist Software Development in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?
Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
As a Senior Staff Specialist Software Development, you will contribute to the digitalization journey by designing and delivering impactful software solutions. Through collaboration, technical expertise, and a continuous improvement mindset, you will help drive meaningful impact.
Design, build and run a web application and platform based on Angular and NestJS that drives digitalization for product portfolio and roadmap management
Collaborate with developers, architects, business analysts, UX experts and business stakeholders to design and build systems that are efficient, effective and scalable
Guide and mentor junior developers
Work in cross-functional Scrum teams and follow DevOps practices and methods 
Explore emerging trends and technologies in software development 
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
 Your ability to mentor others, combined with your strong technical background and collaborative mindset, will be key to driving our digital transformation. By sharing expertise and embracing innovation, you will contribute to delivering scalable solutions and creating value for the business.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Informatics or in a related field 
7+ years of experience in software development with a focus on architectural design and system integration
Expertise in modern web development frameworks (such as Angular, React, Node.js, ASP.NET Core), programming languages and database technologies
Proven mentorship experience, with a focus on guiding and developing both senior and junior software engineers
Strong understanding of cloud technologies, containerization and orchestration tools (such as Kubernetes or OpenShift)
Proficiency in agile methodologies, DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Fluency in English (mandatory)
 Please send us your CV in English.
